image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming near coral. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a golden-yellow posterior body and tail. A distinct black vertical band separates the two color zones. The background consists of textured coral reef structures in muted browns and pinks. There is a text watermark at the bottom center.
